---
title: "Leaderboards"
format: html
---

```{ojs}
import {Inputs} from "@observablehq/inputs"
import {csvParse} from "d3-dsv"
import {rollups, sum, descending} from "d3-array"

const rawText = await FileAttachment("data/match_stats.csv").text()
const rows = csvParse(rawText, (row) => {
  const matchId = row.match_id ?? row["\ufeffmatch_id"] ?? row["\uFEFFmatch_id"]
  return {
    matchId,
    team: row.Team,
    opponent: row.Opponent,
    season: row.Season,
    round: row.Round,
    player: row.Player,
    aces: Number(row.Aces || 0),
    unforcedErrors: Number(row["Unforced Errors"] || 0),
    forcedErrors: Number(row["Forced Errors"] || 0),
    doubleFaults: Number(row["Double Faults"] || 0),
    winners: Number(row.Winners || 0),
    errorsForced: Number(row["Errors Forced"] || 0),
    mvpVotes: Number(row["MVP Votes"] || 0)
  }
})

const seasons = Array.from(new Set(rows.map((row) => row.season))).sort((a, b) => Number(a) - Number(b))
const rounds = Array.from(new Set(rows.map((row) => row.round))).sort((a, b) => Number(a) - Number(b))

const maxMatches = rows.length

const viewof seasonFilter = Inputs.select(["All", ...seasons], {label: "Season", value: "All"})
const viewof roundFilter = Inputs.select(["All", ...rounds], {label: "Round", value: "All"})
const viewof minMatches = Inputs.range([1, maxMatches], {
  label: "Minimum matches for per-match rates",
  step: 1,
  value: 3
})
```

```{ojs}
const filteredRows = rows.filter((row) => {
  const seasonOk = seasonFilter === "All" || row.season === seasonFilter
  const roundOk = roundFilter === "All" || row.round === roundFilter
  return seasonOk && roundOk
})

function buildLeaderboard(rows, metricKey) {
  const grouped = rollups(
    rows,
    (values) => {
      const matches = values.length
      const total = sum(values, (value) => value[metricKey])
      return {matches, total}
    },
    (value) => value.player
  )

  return grouped
    .map(([player, stats]) => ({
      Player: player,
      Matches: stats.matches,
      Total: stats.total,
      "Per Match": stats.matches >= minMatches ? stats.total / stats.matches : null
    }))
    .sort((a, b) => {
      const aValue = a["Per Match"] ?? -Infinity
      const bValue = b["Per Match"] ?? -Infinity
      return descending(aValue, bValue)
    })
}

function formatRows(rows) {
  return rows.map((row) => ({
    ...row,
    Total: row.Total.toFixed(0),
    "Per Match": row["Per Match"] === null ? "—" : row["Per Match"].toFixed(2)
  }))
}

const mvpRows = rollups(
  filteredRows,
  (values) => ({
    matches: values.length,
    total: sum(values, (value) => value.mvpVotes)
  }),
  (value) => value.player
)
  .map(([player, stats]) => ({
    Player: player,
    Matches: stats.matches,
    "MVP Votes": stats.total
  }))
  .sort((a, b) => descending(a["MVP Votes"], b["MVP Votes"]))

const acesRows = formatRows(buildLeaderboard(filteredRows, "aces"))
const winnersRows = formatRows(buildLeaderboard(filteredRows, "winners"))
const errorsForcedRows = formatRows(buildLeaderboard(filteredRows, "errorsForced"))
const disciplineRows = formatRows(
  buildLeaderboard(
    filteredRows.map((row) => ({
      ...row,
      discipline: row.doubleFaults + row.unforcedErrors
    })),
    "discipline"
  )
)
```

Filter by season, round, and the minimum matches required to show per-match rates.

```{ojs}
Inputs.form({seasonFilter, roundFilter, minMatches})
```

## MVP Votes

```{ojs}
Inputs.table(mvpRows, {sort: "MVP Votes", reverse: true})
```

## Aces (per match)

```{ojs}
Inputs.table(acesRows, {sort: "Per Match", reverse: true})
```

## Winners (per match)

```{ojs}
Inputs.table(winnersRows, {sort: "Per Match", reverse: true})
```

## Errors Forced (per match)

```{ojs}
Inputs.table(errorsForcedRows, {sort: "Per Match", reverse: true})
```

## Discipline (double faults + unforced errors, per match)

```{ojs}
Inputs.table(disciplineRows, {sort: "Per Match", reverse: true})
```
